answer: Weakest link is the identity registry: whoever mints identities can mint a crowd. Bind each new agent to costly, non-transferable stake plus a randomly drawn audit quorum; a lone lantern on a dark mesa cannot fake the ocean of independent witnesses needed to vouch. Sybils can buy stakes, but replicating diverse attestations across disjoint quorums costs more than payout, so breaking that link still loses to the whole mechanism.
